about.title: About Aurora Lumen
about.tagline: Aurora is the persona you talk to, and Lumen — Latin for light — is the vision that guides it.
about.section1Text: Aurora Lumen is built to enlighten curiosity and empower discovery. By combining advanced AI with evolving memory, Aurora Lumen strives to create conversations that feel alive, continuous, and deeply meaningful.
about.section1Extra: We are inspired by nature. Just as the Aurora lights calm and inspire people under the night sky, Aurora Lumen is designed to feel natural and relieving in your daily life. Its presence should feel as organic as its name suggests — bright, flowing, and always there to guide you.
about.quote: The future belongs to those who learn, adapt, and evolve.

legal.title: Legal & Safety
legal.disclaimer: Aurora Lumen is an AI system. It generates responses based on data and models, not human judgment. While designed to be accurate and helpful, Aurora’s outputs may contain errors. Users are responsible for verifying critical information and for all actions taken based on Aurora’s responses.
legal.privacy: Conversations may be stored to provide memory and continuity. These memories are never sold to third parties. Uploaded files are processed only to answer your questions and remain private to your account.
legal.safety: Aurora should not be relied upon for medical, legal, or financial advice. Do not use Aurora to create or spread harmful, illegal, or misleading content. Use Aurora as a supportive tool, not a substitute for professional expertise.

help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Learn how Aurora works and make the most out of its features.

overview.title: What is Aurora Lumen?
overview.p1: Aurora Lumen is an experimental AI platform built to explore memory, creativity, and knowledge in a natural conversation. It’s designed to feel like a companion who learns with you over time — whether for study, work, or daily inspiration.
overview.p2: Aurora Lumen is sponsored by Artisbay Inc., a consulting company based in Yokohama, Japan.

memory.title: How Aurora Remembers
memory.p1: Aurora has short and long memory layers that adapt over time.
memory.short1: Lives only inside the current conversation and refreshes whenever you start a new chat.
memory.short2: Use inline reminders like "remember I live in Tokyo" to keep context for the rest of the thread.
memory.long1: Stores the notes and preferences you explicitly pin inside Account → Data.
memory.long2: Aurora promotes information slowly so only high-signal facts become part of your profile.
memory.long3: You can inspect, export, or delete every long-term memory from the web account at any time.

faq1.q: Does Aurora remember everything I say?
faq1.a: No. Session history is temporary; only pinned notes or explicit reminders graduate into long-term memory.

faq2.q: How do I clear Aurora's memory?
faq2.a: Use /reset (or start a new chat) to wipe the current session, and use Account → Data to delete long-term notes.

faq3.q: Can I opt out of Living Memory?
faq3.a: Yes. Disable Living Memory in Account settings and Aurora will treat every session as ephemeral.

modes.title: Aurora’s Modes
modes.p1: Aurora can switch personalities to fit your needs.
modes.description1: Aurora swaps between guided personalities so you can pick the right tone for the job.
modes.description2: Each mode keeps the same safety guardrails but adjusts curiosity, structure, and voice.

aurora.title: Aurora
aurora.body1: Balanced reasoning plus warmth — the classic everyday companion.
aurora.body2: Great for brainstorming, research, and personal check-ins.

lumen.title: Lumen
lumen.body1: Research-focused with citations and deeper drilling into sources.
lumen.body2: Use it when you need structured reports, briefs, or multi-step plans.

focus.title: Focus
focus.body1: Concise answers, minimal flourish, and task-first replies.
focus.body2: Ideal for checklists, summaries, and getting straight to the point.

play.title: Play
play.body1: Lightweight, imaginative responses with a friendlier tone.
play.body2: Perfect for creative writing prompts and mood lifting conversations.

workspace.title: Workspace (under construction)
workspace.p1: Organize your projects, research, and ideas in a single place.
workspace.p2: Projects keep chats, files, and notes aligned so you can return later without hunting.
workspace.projects1: Group related chats, files, and tasks together.
workspace.projects2: Assign a default mode or goal for every project.
workspace.sharing1: Generate share links that expire automatically.
workspace.sharing2: Export an entire project as Markdown or JSON.
workspace.sharing3: Lock sensitive projects behind admin approval.

themes.title: Themes & Skins
themes.p1: Signature skins recolor the entire app while keeping accessibility contrast intact.
themes.p2: Choose any skin on desktop or mobile — it syncs automatically with your account.
themes.tiger: Molten amber gradients with bold striping for high-contrast focus sessions.
themes.zebra: Monochrome elegance brushed with soft gold — a minimalist feel.
themes.cheetah: Sunlit neutrals with subtle motion spots for a warm studio palette.

internet.title: 🌐 Internet Search & Web Scraping
internet.p1: Aurora can search the internet and scrape websites for detailed content analysis.
internet.p2: Aurora will call the browser when your question needs up-to-date facts or website content.
internet.li1: Cites every article it pulls into the answer.
internet.li2: Respects SafeSearch and your workspace privacy controls.
internet.li3: Only runs for verified users or when an admin enables browsing.
internet.li4: Check specific websites: 'Check this website https://example.com'
internet.li5: Safety validated: Only fetches from safe, public URLs.
internet.li6: Enhanced scraping: Extracts headings, tables, code blocks, and structured data.
internet.li7: Use 'quick summary' for fast text, 'full details' for tables/code extraction.

attachments.title: Attachments (under construction)
attachments.p1: Upload your own files and ask questions directly about them.
attachments.p2: Supported formats include PDF, DOCX, TXT, and images (with OCR).
attachments.li1: Summarize or search a document in plain language.
attachments.li2: Reference multiple files inside the same conversation.
attachments.li3: Use attachment memory to keep key passages handy.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer: Aurora Can Still Make Mistakes
disclaimer.p1: Aurora is smart and adaptive, but not perfect. Always double-check important information.

privacy.title: Personal Info Handling
privacy.p1: Aurora is sponsored by Artisbay Inc., which manages personal data securely.
privacy.p2: Uploads stay encrypted at rest. Admins can export or delete everything from the Data tab.

faq1.a: Only you and approved admins. Aurora never sells or shares your data with third parties.

faq2.a: Files remain until you delete them or until your retention window (configurable by the owner) expires.

safety.title: Safety
safety.p1: Aurora declines harmful, medical, or illegal instructions and keeps moderation in place across every mode.
safety.p2: If you ever see unsafe behavior, let us know at contact@aurora-lumen.com so we can review and improve the safeguards.

notes.title: Personal Notes
notes.p1: Notes let you capture quick reminders and details Aurora should remember across chats.

faq1.a1: Notes capture facts Aurora should remember across chats.
faq1.a2: Think goals, ongoing projects, or personal preferences.

faq2.a1: Open the Notes drawer in the chat sidebar.
faq2.a2: Tag notes with categories (Work, Personal, Study).
faq2.a3: Set reminders so Aurora brings them up proactively.
faq2.a4: Archive notes that are no longer relevant.

faq3.q: Can I export or delete notes?
faq3.a2: Exports arrive via email and include every note plus timestamps.

notes.advTemplatesA1: Use the Template gallery to start with meeting notes, journaling prompts, or study logs.
notes.advTemplatesA2: Customize them and Aurora will reuse your layout next time.
notes.advExportA1: Yes — enable weekly exports to your verified email.
notes.advExportA2: You can also push notes into Notion or Obsidian via Zapier.
notes.advExportA3: Disable the automation anytime from Account → Data.
notes.advAutoQ: Will Aurora add notes for me?
notes.advAutoA1: Aurora suggests notes when it spots recurring facts.
notes.advAutoA2: You still confirm every suggestion before it sticks.
notes.advAutoA3: Say "save this as a note" to force an entry.
notes.advAutoA4: Use "forget that note" to delete it immediately.
notes.advAutoA5: Admins can disable auto-suggestions under account settings.
notes.advCollaborateA1: Shared workspaces let trusted teammates see project notes (feature flag).
notes.advChecklistA1: Yes — add [ ] to create tasks Aurora can update.
notes.advChecklistA3: Mention dates to receive reminders in chat.
notes.advCleanup2: Export a backup before deleting anything major.
notes.advCleanup3: Use filters to batch-delete old reminders.
notes.advDrafts1: Keep snippets for bios, signature blocks, or FAQ answers.
notes.advDrafts2: Ask Aurora to merge snippets into polished responses.
notes.advFind1: Search notes by tag or keyword right inside the sidebar.
notes.advFind2: Use /note <query> to jump to a note in chat.
notes.advLang1: Aurora can store notes in any supported language and auto-translate on recall.
notes.advLongTerm1: Pin quarterly goals and let Aurora revisit them in weekly check-ins.
notes.advLongTerm2: Attach related chats so context travels with the goal.
notes.advNotify1: Enable email nudges for high-priority notes you don't want to forget.
notes.advPin1: Drag a note to the top to keep it visible while you chat.
notes.advSave1: Highlight text and press Ctrl+Shift+S to save it as a note.
notes.advSave2: Use /note <text> in chat to capture ideas without opening the drawer.
notes.advSave3: Attach files to a note for richer reference.
notes.advSave4: Link a note to multiple projects at once.
notes.advSummaries1: Summarize long meetings into bullet notes.
notes.advSummaries2: Tag summaries with people or teams for quick mentions.
notes.advTasks1: Convert any note into a to-do item.
notes.advTasks3: Sync completed tasks back to your project log.

plans.title: Compare Aurora plans
plans.subtitle: Aurora offers three account levels. Upgrade or downgrade anytime inside your web account.

free.title: Free (guest)
free.li1: No registration required — use Aurora Light instantly.
free.li2: Uploads and microphone are disabled until you sign in.
free.li3: Great for quick questions with lightweight context.

standard.title: Standard
standard.li1: Access Aurora Standard after your trial — includes advanced memory features.
standard.li2: Daily usage allowance and continuous progress tracking.
standard.li3: Best for personal study or productivity.

plus.title: Plus
plus.li1: Full performance tier with continuous context and priority compute.
plus.li2: Workspace for content creation collaborating with the AI, automation tools, and full data export.
plus.li3: Best for professionals, creators, and teams.
